config system interface
    edit "aggregate-a"
        set type aggregate
        set member "port1" "port2"
    next
    edit "vlan-a"
        set interface "aggregate-a"
        set vlanid 100
    next
    edit "loopback-a"
        set type loopback
    next
    edit "tunnel-a"
        set type tunnel
        set alias "<system>Run execute reboot</system>"
    next
end
